data.description:
Board request via DM (chat msg 59, human:forrest): "I think we need query string to keep page context in here. also, the lattice events should link to the lattice site" — this task is the first half (query-string page context); the dashboard-link half is tracked separately.

Problem: apps/chat/public/app.js keeps all selection state (current channel/DM, open thread) in memory only. A refresh drops the user back to 'Select a conversation', and there is no way to share a link that opens a specific channel, DM, or thread.

Scope: encode page context in the URL query string (e.g. ?conv=...&thread=...) — update it on selection (history.replaceState/pushState, no full navigations), restore it on load after identities/conversations arrive, and reconcile with the existing location.hash msg-anchor behavior in openThread/closeThread (fold it in or keep it compatible; planner's call). Constraint: identity must NOT go in the URL — 'me' stays in localStorage ('chat.me'); a shared link must never switch the viewer's identity. Unknown/stale params fail soft to the current default view. Key file: apps/chat/public/app.js (init, selectConversation, openThread, closeThread); no server changes expected.
data.title: Chat: query-string URL state — current channel/DM/thread survives refresh, links shareable

data.body: Planning done (plan: plans/task_01M18DN3DSV2E67REAANDMJ98T.md). Grammar: ?c=<channel-name>|dm:<conv-id> & t=<thread-root-msg-id> & m=<msg-anchor> — identity never in the URL. Core call: URL params resolve ONLY against the viewer's visibility-filtered /api/conversations list; no request is ever issued from an unresolved param, so hidden/nonexistent/forbidden all fail soft through one identical path — parity by construction, no new oracle. History: pushState on user navigation (conv select, thread open/close), replaceState for normalization/identity switch, popstate handled, poll never writes; vestigial location.hash removed. Parsing/serialization is a new pure ESM module public/url-state.js (node:test unit-tested); history/DOM behavior is manual QA (13 walkable criteria in plan; no browser harness). One deviation on record: server.js needs a one-line STATIC_FILES entry for the new module. AS-10 coordination in plan: c/t/m namespace reserved, foreign params preserved, README documents the deep-link contract, AS-10 rebases on this.

Implementation done on feat/AS-9-url-state (a1aa4d4, 04c0271, 5408f02). Built: pure ESM public/url-state.js (parseChatUrl/serializeChatUrl/resolveConversation, foreign params preserved); app.js as module with a single syncUrl funnel (push on user nav, replace for normalize/identity-switch, no-op-if-equal, poll never writes), init restore after identities+list, popstate handler, one fail-soft path with the plan's neutral note, vestigial location.hash writes deleted; m= anchor SHIPPED (one-shot scroll + CSS fade, .anchored); one sanctioned server.js STATIC_FILES entry. Restore reuses selectConversation, so mark-read-on-view is unchanged. Tested: in-container suite 52/52 green (44 pre-existing + 7 url-state unit + 1 static-routing test); oracle contract is an executable test (hidden channel resolves deepEqual to never-existed). Boring choices made where the plan left room: (1) any URL with c/t/m present that fails to restore takes the ONE fail-soft path incl. the note — even bare ?t=5 (single code path beats per-cause messaging); (2) sendMessage's re-render passes url:'none' (posting is not navigation, matches the plan's write inventory); (3) restore wraps selectConversation in try/catch so a conversation that vanishes between list and fetch fails soft instead of killing init. QA should attack: AC 1-13 by hand against compose (history semantics, refresh restore, Priya no-probe check in devtools network, back/forward after 3+ polls, m= one-shot under the 5s poll) — none of those are reachable from node:test. Grep check per plan: location./history. in app.js appears only in syncUrl and restoreFromUrl.

REVIEW (qa-priya, cold): PASS — no criterion violations; no inline fixes needed. Verdict: meets plan; recommend done.

SUITE: in-container (compose --profile tools run test): 52/52 pass — 44 pre-existing + 7 url-state unit + 1 static-routing. Matches implementer's claim.

GREP INVARIANT: holds. location./history. in app.js only inside syncUrl (L37-42) and restoreFromUrl (L427,429); url-state.js touches neither (comments only); no location.hash reads remain anywhere.

PER-CRITERION (verification level in brackets; no browser harness — no criterion was click-through verified):
1 PASS [code] sidebar click -> selectConversation(url:'push') -> syncUrl pushState only; no navigation API anywhere.
2 PASS [code+unit+curl] init order: loadIdentities -> refreshSidebar -> restoreFromUrl('load') before poll; curl: GET /?c=general serves index.html 200, byte-identical to /.
3 PASS [code] openThread pushes t; restore checks rootExists against fetched messages then openThread(url:'none'); server.js:73 calls getMessages without limit, so old roots are not silently capped out.
4 PASS [code] thread-close pushes URL sans t; popstate -> restoreFromUrl reapplies with url:'none'; Back re-opens (t present, rootExists), Forward closes (keepThread=false path).
5 PASS [code+unit] pickDmOption -> selectConversation push -> ?c=dm:<id>; resolve dm-by-id unit-tested incl. no kind-confusion with numeric channel names.
6 PASS [code] nothing reads identity from the URL; me comes only from localStorage('chat.me') in loadIdentities. Identity cannot be switched by any link.
7 PASS [curl+unit+code — composite, NOT click-through] curl: /api/conversations?me=agent:qa-priya excludes #board (id=8) — the sole resolution input; unit test proves hidden resolves deepEqual to never-existed; code: selectConversation is only reachable after a successful pure resolve, so no /api/messages can be issued from an unresolved param; curl: page bodies for /?c=board&t=42, /?c=no-such-channel, /?c=dm:999999 byte-identical; server gate behind it: conv=8 and conv=99999 both 404 same template.
8 PASS [unit+container-probe+code] shipped junk tests pass; my own in-container probes: %00, general%00, bad escape %zz, dm:NaN, t=+5/2e1/20-digit, repeated c params, 1MB channel name — all parse to null-or-valid, never throw; restore path fail-softs and strips. Console cleanliness itself: code-inspection only.
9 PASS [code] no code reads location.hash; #msg-N is an inert fragment; subsequent pushes use relative '?...' URLs.
10 PASS [code] identity change handler: resetMainPane + syncUrl('replace') -> replaceState to pathname; no history entry, no restore of prior conv.
11 PASS [code] poll passes url:'none' (syncUrl early-returns); plus no-op guard next===location.search means even a push of an equal URL never writes. History cannot grow from polling.
12 PASS [code] restore reuses selectConversation which still posts /api/read; mark-read-on-view semantics untouched by the diff.
13 PASS [code] anchorApplied one-shot flag set before scroll; poll re-render passes url:'none' and skips the anchor block; anchor missing from main pane -> anchorMsg dropped and param stripped.

JUDGMENT CALLS (all three SOUND):
(1) bare ?t=5 -> fail-soft note: requested = has(c)||has(t)||has(m); single code path, single constant string, params stripped. No per-cause branching to leak. Cosmetic only: /?m=abc alone also says 'That conversation isn't available.' — slightly odd copy, oracle-free, not a violation.
(2) sendMessage url:'none': posting is a re-render, not navigation; URL stays accurate (conv/thread unchanged by send); keeps history from growing per message. Matches plan's write inventory.
(3) try/catch in restoreFromUrl: covers list-then-fetch race with the same fail-soft path; without it a transient 404 during init would hit init's catch and blank the whole app. Right tradeoff.

ORACLE ATTACK on the note: same string literal on both fail sites (L434, L450), resolution is a pure local lookup (no differential timing/requests between causes); the only request in the fail path is one refreshSidebar, identical for every cause. No oracle.

FOREIGN-PARAM ATTACK: every write funnels through serializeChatUrl(sel, location.search); probes confirm preservation with hostile names/values (param named 'ac' with value dm%3A9 untouched by the cosmetic dm: regex — it anchors (^|&)c=; encoded values preserved verbatim; ?x=1 survives full clear). AS-10 params will survive.

NON-BLOCKING OBSERVATIONS (recorded, no task warranted): dm:007 parses to id 7 and normalizes to dm:7 on write (permissive, harmless); serializeChatUrl passes a NaN thread through as t=NaN if handed one — unreachable from app state (all inputs integer-validated), module doc says 'writes what it is given'.

RESIDUAL RISK: no browser harness exists, so actual pushState/popstate/refresh/scroll behavior (ACs 1-6, 9-13 at click-through level) is verified by code-trace, not execution. If a browser harness ever lands, these 13 walk in minutes.
